beats.title: Pain
beats.text: AI can build a screen in minutes. Then, six weeks in, a store rule says your checkout must change. Money, rules, what depends on what: none of it was visible. I wish I'd known. Now you start over.

beats.title: What Blueprint is
beats.text: Blueprint is a map of your whole project, before you build. Every decision sits in its column: brand, screens, tech, money, rules, launch. One look, and you see it all.

lines.text: Blueprint is a map of your whole project, before you build.
lines.shot: The screen collapses into one node; the hidden categories become columns; the whole map appears.

lines.text: Every decision sits in its column: brand, screens, tech, money, rules, launch.
lines.shot: Dependency lines draw in; each named column lights up as it is said.

lines.text: One look, and you see it all.
lines.shot: The full map, calm drift.

beats.title: How it works
beats.text: Tap a decision. You get the options, one recommended pick, and the reason why. Compare it with the alternative we set aside. See what else changes if you switch. When it looks right, you approve it.

lines.text: Tap a decision. You get the options, one recommended pick, and the reason why.

lines.text: Compare it with the alternative we set aside.
lines.shot: Tap Compare; the set-aside option slides in beside the pick.

lines.text: See what else changes if you switch.
lines.shot: Dependent decisions light up on the map and in the panel.

lines.text: When it looks right, you approve it.
lines.shot: Tap Approve; the node turns orange: decided by you.

beats.title: Features
beats.text: Add categories as your project grows. Lines show real dependencies, so you see what breaks before it breaks. Lessons from real projects return as foresight: surprises others already hit. AI proposes. Nothing is final until a person says yes. And AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex read the same map, through a local MCP server or a YAML export.
